description: Build a fluid modular type scale as clamp() values that interpolate with the viewport instead of stepping at breakpoints. The narrow end uses a gentler ratio so headlines stay readable on a phone.

base_rem.description: Body size in rem. Defaults to 1.

max_viewport_px.description: Viewport where the scale stops growing. Defaults to 1440.

min_viewport_px.description: Viewport where the scale stops shrinking. Defaults to 360.

name: build_type_scale
